reply.text:
That one is a question about an ACL, so it belongs with a doctor or physio, not a coach. If you're coming back from an injury or have been told to protect that knee, they can tell you exactly what warm-up is right for you.

On the training side, any decent soccer warm-up builds up gradually: easy jogging, dynamic mobility, some jumps and landings, then a few ball-speed cuts and sprints. Once your doctor or physio has cleared you, I'm glad to build you a session or program around whatever they say to avoid.
